name: amyris-hermes
description: Monorepo quality, test, and developer automation for Hermes.

scripts.setup: npm ci --ignore-scripts --workspaces=false && npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix control-plane ci && npm --prefix agent ci && npm --prefix lab/photon-sidecar ci && python3 -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt -r fleet/controller/requirements.txt -r lab/requirements.txt -r lab/skeleton/requirements.txt
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run quality
scripts.lint: eslint . && ruff check fleet/controller lab/skeleton lab/tests fleet/local
scripts.format: prettier --write . && ruff format fleet/controller lab/skeleton lab/tests fleet/local
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && ruff format --check fleet/controller lab/skeleton lab/tests fleet/local
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix control-plane run typecheck && npm --prefix agent run typecheck && npm --prefix lab/photon-sidecar run typecheck && mypy fleet/controller lab/skeleton
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix web run test:unit && npm --prefix control-plane run test:unit && npm --prefix agent test && npm --prefix lab/photon-sidecar test && python3 -m pytest fleet/controller/tests lab/tests -m "not convex_e2e and not live_channel" -n auto --reruns 1 --reruns-delay 1 --durations=20
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix web run test:coverage && npm --prefix control-plane run test:coverage && python3 -m pytest fleet/controller/tests lab/tests -m "not convex_e2e and not live_channel" -n auto --reruns 1 --reruns-delay 1 --cov=fleet/controller --cov=lab/skeleton --cov-report=term --cov-report=xml --cov-fail-under=70
scripts.quality: npm run quality:size && npm run quality:todos && npm run quality:deps && npm run quality:duplicates && npm run docs:check
